title: Pasta with Cream Sauce and Poultry

content.title: About
content.content: Pasta with cream sauce and poultry is a home recipe that combines cooked pasta with a smooth cream sauce made from cream, cheese and spices, together with pieces of chicken or turkey meat. The dish provides carbohydrates, protein and healthy fats for a balanced energy supply.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The cream sauce is often prepared with 10‑30 % cream and finished with grated Parmesan for extra flavor.
Traditionally in Italy, fettuccine or penne are used, but any pasta shape works well.
Chicken is usually sautéed until golden to retain juiciness and aroma.
The whole dish can be ready in under 30 minutes from start to plate.
The sauce can be enriched with mushrooms, spinach or nuts for variety.

items.title: Protein source
items.content: Chicken provides high‑quality protein essential for tissue growth and repair.

items.title: Contains calcium
items.content: Cream and cheese are good sources of calcium, important for bones and teeth.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Poultry is rich in B6 and B12 vitamins, supporting nervous system function and metabolism.

items.title: Healthy fats
items.content: Cream supplies monounsaturated fats that can be heart‑friendly when consumed in moderation.

items.title: Energy density
items.content: The combination of pasta carbohydrates and sauce fats provides lasting satiety.

items.title: High calorie content
items.content: The cream sauce makes the dish calorie‑dense; portion control is advised for weight management.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: Cream and cheese may cause discomfort for people with lactose intolerance.

items.title: Poultry allergy
items.content: A small number of individuals may be allergic to poultry; substitute with another protein if needed.

items.title: Sodium level
items.content: Salt and cheese increase sodium; those with hypertension should limit added salt.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the pasta hot, tossed with the sauce and meat pieces. Garnish with fresh herbs, grated Parmesan or a pinch of black pepper. It pairs well with a light salad or vegetable side.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 2‑3 days. Reheat gently, adding a splash of cream or water to restore sauce consistency.
